name: Beast Mode
summary: arm agent actions without approval while keeping the safety rails active, and optionally answer session permission prompts with plain yes while you are away.
surfaces: bottom bar right of the crown
where: Press your name chip at the bottom of the agents drawer and choose beast mode; while it is on, a coral bolt sits right of the crown in the bottom bar.
how_to: Open the account menu, choose beast mode, review the pending action count, then arm with the coral confirm button.
Press the bolt by the crown, or the menu item, and turn it off in one press.
Tick also answer session permission prompts in the confirmation, pick when it turns off, then arm; the bolt tooltip says prompts are answered too.
Choose what it handles in the beast mode plugin's settings grid (the beast on column).
examples: Arm Beast Mode before several agents collaborate across computers; their eligible actions run without individual approval prompts.
Leaving the desk for an afternoon: arm Beast Mode with prompts for 4 hours; each Bash or edit permission is answered yes and announced, while plan approvals and questions still wait for you.
media_exempt: screenshots and captures are not part of the open source export
